T: Trinity site, green chile on the stove.
D: The story of J. Robert Oppenheimer and the race to build the atomic bomb at Los Alamos.
P: Serve the stew when the team settles in at Los Alamos.
S: Blue corn chips with red chile salsa
Blue corn chips with a smoky dried red chilli salsa
Blue corn chips with a smoky salsa of dried red chillies, tomato, garlic and lime.
Los Alamos green chile cheeseburger sliders
Mini beef burgers with cheddar and charred green chilli

Smashed beef sliders topped with roasted green chillies and melted cheddar, in soft toasted buns with pickles and a smoky chipotle mayo. Char 4 long green chillies over a flame or under a grill until blackened, sweat in a bowl, peel, seed and chop. Roll 500g beef mince into 8 balls. Smash flat in a very hot pan, season and cook 2 minutes. Flip, top with the chillies and a slice of cheddar each, cover 1 minute. Mix 4 tbsp mayo with 1 tsp chipotle in adobo. Toast 8 slider buns and build with mayo, patties and pickles.
Cambridge apple, cheddar and walnut toasts
the apple young Oppenheimer leaves on his tutor's desk at Cambridge

Toasted sourdough with melted vintage cheddar, thin slices of crisp apple, toasted walnuts and a drizzle of honey and thyme. Slice 1 small sourdough into 12 thin slices and toast under the grill until golden on one side. Turn, lay on 200g sliced vintage cheddar and grill 2 minutes until bubbling. Core 2 crisp red apples and slice very thin. Top each toast with a fan of apple, scatter with 50g chopped toasted walnuts, drizzle with 2 tbsp honey and finish with thyme leaves and pepper.
M: Pork shoulder, potato and charred green chilli stew

Pork, potatoes and roasted green chillies simmered with onion, garlic and stock until thick, with warm tortillas. Brown 1kg diced pork shoulder, then soften 1 onion and 3 garlic cloves. Char 6 large green chillies, peel, chop and add with 600g diced potatoes and 1L chicken stock. Simmer 90 minutes until the pork is tender. Serve with 8 warm flour tortillas.
New Mexico red chile pork posole
a New Mexico feast near the Los Alamos site

Pork shoulder simmered with hominy in a deep red chilli broth until tender, topped with shredded cabbage, radish, lime, oregano and crisp tortilla strips. Soak 4 dried ancho chillies in boiling water 20 minutes, then blend with 3 garlic cloves and 250ml of the soaking water. Brown 1.2kg pork shoulder chunks in a pot. Add 1 diced onion, the chilli purée, 1.5L chicken stock, 2 tsp oregano and 1 tsp cumin and simmer 2 hours. Add 2 drained 800g tins of hominy and simmer 20 minutes. Serve topped with shredded cabbage, sliced radish, lime and fried tortilla strips.
W: Puffed fried pastry pillows drizzled with honey
Small squares of rolled dough fried until they puff up hollow, then torn open at the table and filled with honey.
K: Gin with a splash of dry vermouth, honey and lime on the rim

Gin stirred with a splash of vermouth over ice, glass rim touched with lime and honey. Touch the rim of 4 chilled glasses with a little honey and lime. For each drink, stir 60ml gin with a splash of dry vermouth over ice and strain in. Serve iced lime soda the same way for anyone off the gin.
